original.theorem: Every source q in each covered square lies in the convex hull of stations within 1000m of every square point. Any closed emission half-plane through q contains at least one such station; otherwise all convex-combination projections would be strictly negative. Complete dyadic partition covers the domain. This is a continuous certificate, not sampled directions.
original.limitation: Validates these exact finite-decimal stations under the stated geometric model, not their correct use in a solver or official simulator behavior.

proof: Orthogonal transport of continuous certificate; floating checks are not a replacement exact certificate
